02 · That smile

The one I’d know anywhere

Big, a little crooked, completely real. It shows up when she’s proud, when she’s shy, and when someone points a camera at her. It’s the first thing I fell for, and it hasn’t worn off once.

“Even half hidden behind flowers, you’re the first thing I see.”
